import math


def r(x):
    # Maps x in [0, 1] to 1 - x, which is also in [0, 1].
    # This mirrors the feature distance from the decision boundary (at x = 0.5).
    return 1.0 - float(x)


def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # Due to the radial symmetry of the dataset and the RBF kernel,
    # the probability of being classified as class 1 at distance d from the boundary
    # is conserved as the complement of the probability at distance -d.
    # Therefore, P(x) + P(1-x) should approximately equal 1.0.
    return abs(y_orig + y_new - 1.0) < 0.18
